fact: On 11 August 2026 the Justice Ministry's under-secretary said the ministry is preparing three draft laws with the digital transformation ministry, among them a 2026 Law on Regulating Data and Artificial Intelligence, to provide the legislative framework including data protection.

fact: On 6 August 2026 the Council of Ministers discussed the digital transformation ministry's draft bills, including a data and artificial intelligence bill, and directed further study before approval by the interim parliament, a joint sitting of the Sovereignty and Ministers councils; the article does not describe the bill's content.
The analyst Al-Sadiq Mohamed Ahmed writes that Sudan lacks an independent, comprehensive law on personal data protection, and calls for one to be drafted and adopted.
The analyst writes that Sudan has no independent national commission to monitor compliance with data protection.
